title: mocon host record
description: core.md section 5.1. The capabilities declaration. Key (host, "host"). No id. A host MUST emit this before any other record for that host in every stream it opens.

host.description: Opaque string identifying the declaring host. Recommended form vendor/product[/profile].

unmediated_egress.description: Absent reads as unknown, which consumers treat like true.

attested.description: Entries from the list in provenance.md section 4, which grows by minor version (core.md section 8). Absent reads as []. This schema validates the shape (a string array), not membership in a specific version's list, so a 1.0 schema does not reject a future minor version's entries; a consumer ignores an entry it does not know. The 1.1 list is: crossing.target, crossing.input, crossing.output, crossing.error, execution.error.class, ext.declared.

dimensions.description: core.md section 5.1.1. Maps an ext key name, exactly as it appears on the wire, to a declaration of what that key means. Absent reads as {}. Per host string: a re-declaration with a different map is a conflict. Keys may name ext keys only, never a core field.

agg.description: One of sum, last, none in 1.1. This schema validates the shape (a string), not membership in a specific version's list, for the same reason attested does: a 1.1 schema must not reject a future minor version's value, and a consumer that meets an unknown one reads the whole entry as absent (core.md section 8). How a consumer may combine values of this key: sum means the values are additive, last means each is a level, none means it is not a quantity. sum and last apply only to a finite JSON number; a non-number under either is a mismatch and reads as undeclared for that record.

unit.description: The unit of the value, compared only by equality and copied verbatim into an exporter's instrument unit. Absent reads as "1". Meaningful only under agg sum or last.

card.description: low or high in 1.1; the shape, not the membership, is validated here, as for agg. How many distinct values to expect. Absent reads as "high", so a key is display-only until the host opts it in. Read only under agg none. Grows by minor version like agg.

name.description: Display name. Absent, a consumer displays the key itself.

observed.description: The host determines this value at a point the program cannot write through. Absent reads as false. It upgrades the key to host-observed only together with the ext.declared entry in attested (provenance.md section 4).

ext.description: Open map of namespaced keys, vendor.key. The mocon. namespace is reserved to the specification (core.md section 3). Core consumers ignore it; relays preserve it.
